name: Ho Quoc Pagoda
kicker: Trúc Lâm pagoda facing the sea
summary: Sea-facing pagoda in Dương Tơ: walk the triple gate and the courtyard, about 25 km from Dương Đông. It was inaugurated in 2012 in ấp Suối Lớn, inside a spiritual project of over 110 ha, in Lý–Trần form, with a main hall, an ancestor house, and lim-wood columns. Sun World’s account puts the temple grounds at about 13.2 ha and says the gate takes no ticket.
getThere: About 25 km from Dương Đông, in ấp Suối Lớn
heroCaption: The yellow triple gate at Chùa Hộ Quốc, with the stair and the hill behind
body: Walk the triple gate, the courtyard, and the halls that face the sea. A 2019 article on phatgiao.org.vn places Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Hộ Quốc in ấp Suối Lớn, xã Dương Tơ, and says the coastal road has the sea on one side and a limestone hill on the other. The same article says the spiritual project covers over 110 ha, the buildings follow Lý and Trần form, the temple was inaugurated in 2012, and the main works are the main hall, the ancestor house, and the triple gate, with lim-wood columns. Sun World’s Hon Thom news account gives the inauguration as 14 December 2012, the project as 110 ha, and the temple itself as about 13.2 ha, with the rest forest. The “over 110 ha” and the “110 ha” both stay.

Sun World puts the temple about 25 km from thị trấn Dương Đông and says the gate takes no ticket, with parking as a donation. The same account says a free vegetarian lunch runs from 11:00 to 17:00 beside the main hall. Read the board at the gate for the day’s hours. The white figure and the gold roofs in the courtyard are the frame you came for.

figures.caption: The courtyard roofs at Ho Quoc, with the sea on the horizon
figures.alt: Courtyard and tiled roofs of Ho Quoc Pagoda with the sea behind

gettingThere: Sun World’s account puts Chùa Hộ Quốc about 25 km from thị trấn Dương Đông, in ấp Suối Lớn, xã Dương Tơ. The 2019 article describes the last stretch as a coastal road, sea on one side and a limestone hill on the other. Go by motorbike or car and leave the bike at the gate.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 25 km to ấp Suối Lớn in Dương Tơ, on the Sun World account. The 2019 article sends you along the coastal road into the temple.

legs.heading: From the south road
legs.body: Dương Tơ sits on the way between the airport and the south. Pair the temple with Bãi Sao or the cable car on a south morning.

admissionNote: Sun World’s Hon Thom news account says the gate takes no entry ticket and that parking is a donation. It also says a vegetarian lunch is free from 11:00 to 17:00. Read the board at the gate for the day’s hours.
